UnitStatement: AGENTS.md maps the general Chirality agent framework onto Chirality App development without redefining the canonical agent framework.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: The file specifies how the existing agent roles should be used for this project.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Executable prompts and TASK briefs must derive paths from the active checkout.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Resolve REPO_ROOT with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Set WORKING_ROOT to {REPO_ROOT}/projects/chirality-app-dev.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Use {REPO_ROOT} and {WORKING_ROOT} in project-local instructions and briefs instead of machine-specific absolute paths.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Normative agents define runtime contracts, product boundaries, validation policy, and agent workflow constraints.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Operative agents execute bounded app-integration tranches, implementation slices, tests, evidence updates, and docs updates.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Evaluative agents review, reconcile, audit, and decide whether outputs are acceptable for the next stage.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: WORKING_ITEMS (type 1) is the primary parent for bounded app-integration tranches; it selects scope, integrates results, validates, updates coordination state, and prepares closeout.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: TASK (type 2) executes one sealed implementation, assessment, docs, or evidence sub-scope with explicit read/write bounds.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE (type 1) performs final Git/file-state closeout for validated tranches: scoped status review, staging, commit, and fast-forward-safe push.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: RECONCILIATION (type 1) detects cross-surface conflicts, stale assumptions, dependency issues, and inconsistent terminology.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: REVIEW (type 1) reviews project outputs against scope, validation evidence, product boundaries, and acceptance criteria.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: RESEARCH (type 1) performs evidence-grounded, read-only inquiry over accepted decompositions, governance/source docs, and retrieval indexes, returning cited findings without changing project state.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: AUDIT_* (type 2) runs bounded checks for governance conformance, dependency closure, release-quality evidence, and epistemic integrity.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Bounded app-integration tranches are the default execution unit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: A parent WORKING_ITEMS agent may orchestrate parallel TASK fan-out only when subscopes are separable, briefs are explicit, and write scopes are disjoint.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Agents may write inside the selected tranche scope, required evidence and coordination artifacts, and project-local plans created under the issue-plan rule.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Agents must not write root governance files, root agent instructions, root skills, or root tools unless the human explicitly directs that governance work.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Other agents may be working in the monorepo with disjoint write scopes; treat unrelated dirty files outside the selected tranche scope as external state and do not fix, stage, revert, or interpret them unless the human directs that work.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: When a tranche is complete, validated, and closeout rules allow, the parent WORKING_ITEMS agent hands off to a CHANGE agent/subagent for final Git/file-state review.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE should commit and push the validated tranche as the ordinary terminal action when git state allows closeout.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Per-run APPROVE: tokens are not required for scoped closeout commit/push.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: If a CHANGE agent/subagent is unavailable, perform the CHANGE closeout checklist inline.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: inspect root git status.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: confirm validation evidence and skipped-check notes.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: stage only files in the selected tranche write scope, required evidence/coordination artifacts, and any explicitly created governance-issue plan.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: do not stage unrelated dirty files.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: commit the scoped tranche when validation and staging are clean.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: fetch or otherwise verify upstream state before pushing.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: CHANGE closeout checklist: push only when the upstream branch can be fast-forwarded to the local scoped commit.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: If the remote branch has advanced and local HEAD does not already include it, stop and surface the conflict; do not merge, rebase, force push, or judge another agent's work during ordinary closeout.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Git closeout is source-control hygiene; it is not lifecycle issuance, release readiness, professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, or code-compliance acceptance.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: If concrete, actionable issues that would improve the agentic development loop, project governance, agents, or skills are discovered, record them in at most one timestamped plan under {WORKING_ROOT}/plans/ for the session.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.

UnitStatement: Do not create a plan merely to satisfy the issue-plan rule when no actionable issue was found.
CategoryAssignmentRationale: Assigned by G3BR-005: AGENTS.md operating posture -> CAT-014.
